headline: Approved six resolutions in cases involving properties on Whitney Avenue, Leeder Hill, Hamden Hills Drive and Dixwell Avenue.
summary: The meeting went into executive session to discuss settling pending tax appeals against the town. After returning to open session, the committee voted unanimously to accept counsel's recommendations on six resolutions.
decisions: Approved the resolution in the South Central Connecticut Regional Water Authority case covering six Whitney Avenue and Armory Street area properties, unanimously (all in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions).
Approved the resolution in the Whitney Center, Incorporated case for 200 Leeder Hill, Hamden, unanimously (all in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions).
Approved the resolution in the Hamden Developers, LLC case for 45 Hamden Hills Drive, unanimously (all in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions).
Approved the resolution in the Jodie R. Small, Trustee case for 2243 Dixwell Avenue, unanimously (all in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions).
Approved the resolution in the Roger L. Benedict, Trustee case for 2235 Dixwell Avenue, unanimously (all in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions).
Approved the resolution in the Northington Hamden Investors, LLC case for 2335 Dixwell Avenue and 2335 Rear, unanimously (all in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions).

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ADMINISTRATION & SETTLEMENT 
COMMITTEE MINUTES 
 
6:30 PM, OCTOBER 5, 2026 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Committee Members: 
Present - Tameeka Parks 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Absent - Doug Foley 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Ex-Officio Voting: 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj. 
Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Min. Leader 
Ex-Officio Non-Voting: 
Present - Katie Kiely, President 
    
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Administration and Settlement Meeting, October 5, 2026 - 6:30pm.  Vice Chair Alston 
called the meeting to order at 6:38pm with the members noted above in attendance.  
Chair Caldwell and Majority Leader Gallagher arrived after roll call.  
    
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to provide public comment and Public Input was closed at 6:38pm.  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Vice Chair Alston noted the upcoming meetings for the Civil Service, Board of Ethics and 
Retirement Board meetings and mentioned the most recent year-to-date reports for the 
departments noted below were included in the agenda packet.  
  
 
Human Resources/Civil Service Update 
  
 
Legislative Council Update 
  
 
Town Government Center Update 
  
 
Probate Court Update 
  
 
Town Attorney Update 
  
4. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
Vice Chair Alston announced that the Administration and Settlement Committee would be 
going into Executive session along with Attorney Gruen and Attorney Blank.   He called for 
a motion to enter Executive Session.   The motion was made by Minority Leader Anthony. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Motion passed unanimously  
  1. DISCUSSION REGARDING SETTLEMENT OF PENDING TAX APPEALS AGAINST 
THE TOWN. 
  
5. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA 
Vice Chair called the committee back to order and called the roll.  In addition to Vice Chair 
Alston, the following members were present – Parks, Hunt, Osmanu, Webber, Gallagher, 
and Anthony. 
Vice Chair Alston called for a motion to bundle the 4 items on the agenda.  The motion 
was made by Minority Leader Anthony and seconded by Council member Osmanu.
Vote:  All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Motion to bundle passed unanimously. 
 
Vice Chair Alston then called for a motion to receive these items and accept 
recommendations from counsel.  
  1. VOTE ON RESOLUTION - South Central Connecticut Regional Water Authority v. 
Town of Hamden - 900 Whitney Avenue, 920 Whitney Avenue, 940 Whitney Avenue, 
65 Armory Street, 150 Sanford Street, 0 Talmadge Road 
  
  2. VOTE ON RESOLUTION - Whitney Center, Incorporated v. Town of Hamden - 200 
Leeder Hill, Hamden 
  
  3. VOTE ON RESOLUTION - Hamden Developers, LLC v. Town of Hamden - 45 
Hamden Hills Drive 
  
  4. VOTE ON RESOLUTION: Jodie R. Small, Trustee Et Al v, Town of Hamden - 2243 
Dixwell Avenue 
 
VOTE ON RESOLUTION: Roger L. Benedict, Trustee Et Al v, Town of Hamden, 
2235 Dixwell Avenue) 
 
VOTE ON RESOLUTION: Northington Hamden Investors, LLC Et Al v. Town of 
Hamden - 2335 Dixwell Avenue/ 2335 Rear 
 
The motion was made by Minority Leader Anthony and seconded by Council member 
Osmanu. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Motion to bundle passed unanimously. 
 
The motion was made by Minority Leader Anthony and seconded by Council member 
Webber.   
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Items passed unanimously. 
  
6. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting  
7. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting  
8. ADJOURN  
Vice Chair Alston mentioned once again the upcoming boards and commission meetings 
and noted the links to their calendars.  With no additional business before the committee, 
Vice Chair Alston adjourned the meeting at 7:26pm.
